## Review checklist (quality-testing-strategy.md, section 4)

**Author**

- [ ] CI is green: `mvn -B verify` compiles and all tests pass.
- [ ] Each use case flow in scope (main, alternative, exception) has acceptance tests.
- [ ] Surefire and JaCoCo results are attached or linked.
- [ ] Documentation, `CHANGELOG.md` and `DECISIONS.md` are updated when the change affects them.

**Reviewer** (never the author)

- [ ] The PR matches its issue and stays within its scope.
- [ ] Interfaces are unchanged, or the change has a recorded decision in `DECISIONS.md`.
- [ ] Role checks exist where needed.
- [ ] No real data, credentials or secrets.
- [ ] No unjustified new dependency.
- [ ] Commits and branch name follow `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
